006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDefinitionNodeItem;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModelElementVisitor;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
020
021import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;
022import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
023
024import java.util.Collection;
025import java.util.HashSet;
026import java.util.LinkedList;
027import java.util.List;
028import java.util.Set;
029import java.util.stream.Collectors;
030import java.util.stream.Stream;
031
032import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
033import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
034import nl.talsmasoftware.lazy4j.Lazy;
035
036/**
037 * A set of constraints, which are targeted at the contents of a Metaschema
038 * module within specific contexts.
039 */
040@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
041public class MetaConstraintSet
042    extends AbstractConstraintSet {
043  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(MetaConstraintSet.class);
044  @NonNull
045  private final List<? extends IConstraintSet> imports;
046  @NonNull
047  private final List<Context> contexts;
048
049  /**
050   * Construct a new constraint set.
051   *
052   * @param source
053   *          the source of the constraint set
054   * @param imports
055   *          other constraint sets imported by this set
056   * @param contexts
057   *          the contexts to use for this constraint set
058   */
059  public MetaConstraintSet(
060      @NonNull ISource source,
061      @NonNull List<? extends IConstraintSet> imports,
062      @NonNull List<Context> contexts) {
063    super(source);
064    this.imports = imports;
065    this.contexts = contexts;
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  public Collection<? extends IConstraintSet> getImportedConstraintSets() {
070    return imports;
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public void applyConstraintsForModule(
075      IModuleNodeItem moduleItem,
076      IModelElementVisitor<ITargetedConstraints, Void> visitor) {
077
078    for (IConstraintSet imported : imports) {
079      imported.applyConstraintsForModule(moduleItem, visitor);
080    }
081
082    IModule module = moduleItem.getModule();
083    if (LOGGER.isDebugEnabled()) {
084      LOGGER.atDebug().log("Applying '{}' constraints to '{}' module.",
085          getSource().getLocationHint(),
086          module.getLocationHint());
087    }
088
089    // generate a dynamic context using the external constraint set's static context
090    DynamicContext dynamicContext = new DynamicContext(getSource().getStaticContext());
091    for (Context context : contexts) {
092      context.applyConstraintsForModule(
093          moduleItem,
094          dynamicContext,
095          visitor,
096          ISequence.of(moduleItem));
097    }
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * A nestable context, targeted by a set of metapath expressions, to apply
102   * constraints within.
103   */
104  public static class Context {
105    @NonNull
106    private final List<IMetapathExpression> metapaths;
107    @NonNull
108    private final Lazy<List<IMetapathExpression>> contextualizedMetapaths;
109    @NonNull
110    private final List<Context> childContexts = new LinkedList<>();
111    @NonNull
112    private final Lazy<ITargetedConstraints> constraints;
113    @NonNull
114    private final Set<IDefinition> previouslyTargetedDefinitions = new HashSet<>();
115
116    /**
117     * Construct a new context.
118     *
119     * @param parent
120     *          the parent content or {@code null} if there is no parent
121     * @param source
122     *          the source of the constraint set
123     * @param metapaths
124     *          the metapath expressions the context applies to
125     * @param modelConstrained
126     *          the constraints to apply to items matching one of the metapaths
127     */
128    public Context(
129        @Nullable Context parent,
130        @NonNull ISource source,
131        @NonNull List<IMetapathExpression> metapaths,
132        @NonNull IModelConstrained modelConstrained) {
133      this.metapaths = metapaths;
134      this.contextualizedMetapaths = ObjectUtils.notNull(Lazy.lazy(() -> {
135        return concatMetapaths(parent, ObjectUtils.notNull(metapaths.stream()), source)
136            .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
137      }));
138
139      this.constraints = ObjectUtils.notNull(Lazy.lazy(() -> new ModelTargetedConstraints(
140          source,
141          this::getContextualizedMetapaths,
142          modelConstrained)));
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * Get the set of constraints associated with this context.
147     *
148     * @return the set of constraints
149     */
150    @NonNull
151    private ITargetedConstraints getConstraints() {
152      return ObjectUtils.notNull(constraints.get());
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * Add a collection of child contexts to this context.
157     *
158     * @param children
159     *          the children context to add
160     */
161    public void addAll(@NonNull Collection<Context> children) {
162      childContexts.addAll(children);
163    }
164
165    @NonNull
166    private List<IMetapathExpression> getMetapaths() {
167      return metapaths;
168    }
169
170    @NonNull
171    private List<IMetapathExpression> getContextualizedMetapaths() {
172      return ObjectUtils.notNull(contextualizedMetapaths.get());
173    }
174
175    void applyConstraintsForModule(
176        @NonNull IModuleNodeItem moduleItem,
177        @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
178        @NonNull IModelElementVisitor<ITargetedConstraints, Void> visitor,
179        @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> contextItems) {
180      ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targetedItems = ISequence.of(ObjectUtils.notNull(
181          contextItems.stream()
182              .flatMap(item -> getMetapaths().stream()
183                  .flatMap(metapath -> metapath.evaluate(item, dynamicContext).stream()
184                      .filter(result -> filterNonDefinitionItem(result, metapath))
185                      .map(result -> (IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>) result)))))
186          .reusable();
187
188      // process this context
189      Set<IDefinition> definitions = targetedItems.stream()
190          .map(IDefinitionNodeItem::getDefinition)
191          // ensure the definition only gets processed if the module being processed is
192          // the containing module
193          .filter(definition -> !previouslyTargetedDefinitions.contains(definition))
194          .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet());
195
196      // apply the constraints for this context
197      definitions.forEach(definition -> {
198        definition.accept(visitor, getConstraints());
199      });
200      previouslyTargetedDefinitions.addAll(definitions);
201
202      // process child contexts, which will be applied depth first
203      for (Context childContext : childContexts) {
204        childContext.applyConstraintsForModule(
205            moduleItem,
206            dynamicContext,
207            visitor,
208            targetedItems);
209      }
210    }
211
212    @NonNull
213    private static Stream<IMetapathExpression> concatMetapaths(
214        @Nullable MetaConstraintSet.Context parent,
215        @NonNull Stream<IMetapathExpression> metapaths,
216        @NonNull ISource source) {
217
218      Stream<IMetapathExpression> retval = metapaths;
219      if (parent != null) {
220        List<IMetapathExpression> parentMetapaths = parent.getMetapaths().stream()
221            .collect(Collectors.toList());
222        retval = metapaths
223            .map(IMetapathExpression::getPath)
224            .flatMap(childPath -> parentMetapaths.stream()
225                .map(parentPath -> parentPath.getPath() + '/' + childPath))
226            .map(metapath -> IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(
227                ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(metapath),
228                source.getStaticContext()));
229      }
230      return ObjectUtils.notNull(retval);
231    }
232
233    private static boolean filterNonDefinitionItem(IItem item, @NonNull IMetapathExpression metapath) {
234      boolean retval = item instanceof IDefinitionNodeItem;
235      if (!retval) {
236        LOGGER.atError().log(
237            "Found non-definition item '{}' while applying external constraints using target expression '{}'.",
238            item.toString(),
239            metapath.getPath());
240      }
241      return retval;
242    }
243  }
244}
